note: A script is ACTIVE_RUNTIME when some .github/workflows/*.yml invokes it (directly, or as a subprocess of a script that a workflow invokes). py_compile in strategy_tests.yml is NOT a consumer: compiling a file proves it parses, not that anything runs it. Having no workflow is NOT by itself grounds for DEAD_ORPHANED: a script that documents its own manual invocation and states what it is for is LEGACY_INTENTIONAL, the same treatment the dispatch-only smoke tests get — the operator is the consumer. DEAD_ORPHANED is reserved for scripts whose declared purpose is contradicted by the repository, e.g. a module that presents itself as a numbered stage of a pipeline that does not call it.
